subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should #86567 remain as a tracking umbrella, or should maintainers split and close it once canonical sub-issues cover dashboard auth, Codex auth migration, runtime/update atomicity, and long-session liveness?
rationale: The issue mixes security-sensitive auth persistence, provider migration, installer/update compatibility, message delivery, and context-management product behavior, so automation cannot safely choose one implementation or closure boundary.

options.title: Split into canonical sub-issues
options.body: Create or bless focused sub-issues for each remaining surface, link the already-open overlaps such as #98472, and close or convert the umbrella only after that map exists.

options.title: Keep as tracking umbrella
options.body: Leave #86567 open as the broad field-report tracker while focused PRs continue to land under related narrower issues.

options.title: Close after declaring existing coverage sufficient
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide existing doctor/auth/compaction fixes plus open related issues fully cover every acceptance criterion.

recommendation.title: Split into canonical sub-issues
recommendation.body: Create or bless focused sub-issues for each remaining surface, link the already-open overlaps such as #98472, and close or convert the umbrella only after that map exists.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent history across both dashboard auth and agent liveness/compaction surfaces, making him the best single routing owner among the sampled history.
